newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Flextech buys Spire Tech for S$1.66 mln.
newsitem.headline: Flextech buys Spire Tech for S$1.66 mln.

text.p: Electronics and industrial distributor Flextech Holdings Ltd said on Monday it had entered into an agreement to buy Spire Technology Pte Ltd for Singapore S1.66 million.
A statement said Flextech would buy 80,000 ordinary shares, representing 80 percent of the issued and paid-up capital of Spire, at S$1 each.
Spire distributes wafer probe accessories such as burn-in sockets and specialised chemical products' wafer probe cards, the statement said.
The acquisition will be funded internally, it added.
